name: The centre of the bridge
description: A railroad bridge over a swift stream twenty feet below, with loose boards laid on the sleepers as a temporary platform.

features.name: The wooden pier at the south end
features.description: Where the flood of last winter lodged a great quantity of driftwood.

features.name: The plank
features.description: Spans three of the cross-ties; held in place by weight.

exits.description: the foot planking to the north bank
